02 / SEO · Growth

Knitto

Built and executed on-page, off-page, and technical SEO programs, using content systems and performance analysis to turn search visibility into qualified leads.

1.63× traffic 1.73× impressions 3.15% ranking boost 1.5× leads 10 Discover features 100%+ KPI
Case details+

Challenge

A Google Core Update and the long Eid break pushed traffic down 14.79% and impressions down 30% in March-April 2025.

Approach

Audited dropped pages in Search Console and Semrush, refreshed content around current intent and E-E-A-T, fixed technical and mobile UX issues, strengthened internal links, and published into proven topic clusters.

Recovery

By May-June, traffic recovered by 20.3% and impressions by 26%, moving both beyond their previous levels.
